Given the seemingly infinite number of ways that the Foundationverse could have ended before SCP-094 becomes a threat, I wouldn't be surprised if one of these relevant threats gets more attention later.

Thanks for reading it!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Very nice. This has a good mix of optimism and melancholy to it and as Phoenix said it does a good job of feeling almost entirely original- a natural extension of the premise. I really enjoy this small glance into the type of world or future that may never be seen again on the site.

item.content:encoded:
ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: TROPELESS END-OF-THE-WORLD-TALE

In all honesty, thanks for reading and upvoting. I was worried this wouldn't be long enough and that I'd have to find a way to add some beef to it. I'm happy it works at the length it is now.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: This was good! I like that it's short and sweet—not all end-of-the-world stories need to be packed to the brim with melodrama and terror to be enjoyable. It's almost an achievement that you told this kind of story without the usual tropes. And the fact that humanity has colonized the stars gives some sense of hope right from the beginning. +1

I really like this!

Two minor word choice suggestions though:

Replace world with universe in the sentence about Bright being the last, as world implies life on a singular planet (which is no longer the case).

In the sentence about the inside of the event horizon, laid should be lay.

Hello readers!

This is my first tale; I was surprised to see that 094 had no tales, so, as part of the 2018 Underloved Series I challenge, I decided to give it one.

Shoutout to LadyKatie for crit and reassuring me this idea didn't suck.

Thanks for reading,
